body_html:
How to think about it

  • Line up the ones and regroup where needed.
  • Round to estimate: 48,615 + 23,290 ≈ 49,000 + 23,000 = 72,000.
  • Check subtraction by adding.

Examples

Example

A train travels 1,348 km and then 2,795 km.

1,348 + 2,795

Answer: 4,143 km

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Misaligned columnsLine up from the ones.
Forgetting to regroupCarry or borrow when a column needs it.

A city library had 64,005 books. It gave away 8,368 old books and then bought 5,275 new books. How many books does it have now?
items.e: Step 1, after giving away: 64,005 − 8,368 = 55,637. Step 2, after buying: 55,637 + 5,275 = 60,912.

items.q: On Saturday, 34,568 fans watched a match at one stadium and 28,795 fans watched a match at another. On Sunday, 72,000 fans watched the cup final. How many more fans watched the cup final than the two Saturday matches?
items.e: Step 1, fans on Saturday: 34,568 + 28,795 = 63,363. Step 2, find the difference: 72,000 − 63,363 = 8,637.

items.q: Ashford has 74,385 people. Brookfield has 18,640 more people than Ashford. How many people live in the two towns altogether?
items.e: Step 1, people in Brookfield: 74,385 + 18,640 = 93,025. Step 2, both together: 74,385 + 93,025 = 1,67,410.

items.q: Imran’s family wants to buy a house for ₹3,25,000. They have saved ₹42,750 and sold their flat for ₹2,15,800. How much more money do they need?
A warehouse had 1,25,400 parcels. It sent out 87,965 parcels, then a lorry delivered 46,580 more. How many parcels are in the warehouse now?
items.e: Step 1, after sending: 1,25,400 − 87,965 = 37,435. Step 2, after the delivery: 37,435 + 46,580 = 84,015.

items.q: A theatre sold 65,820 tickets in 2,024. In 2,025 it sold 8,475 fewer tickets. How many tickets did it sell in the two years?
A charity had ₹82,450. It spent ₹36,780 on a minibus and ₹19,965 on sports equipment. Then a local business gave it ₹15,000. How much money does the charity have now?
A house was worth ₹2,85,000. Its value fell by ₹17,450, then rose by ₹32,800. What is the house worth now?
Gauri’s family drove 12,486 km in 2,023 and 14,075 km in 2,024. In 2,025 they drove 11,938 km. How much further did they drive in 2,023 and 2,024 together than in 2,025?
items.e: Step 1, 2,023 and 2,024: 12,486 km + 14,075 km = 26,561 km. Step 2, find the difference: 26,561 km − 11,938 km = 14,623 km.

items.q: Kabir’s dad is a lorry driver. This year he plans to drive 1,00,000 km. He drove 45,120 km from January to June and 37,465 km from July to October. How many kilometres are left to drive this year?
items.e: Step 1, kilometres driven: 45,120 km + 37,465 km = 82,585 km. Step 2, kilometres left: 1,00,000 km − 82,585 km = 17,415 km. Check: 17,415 km + 82,585 km = 1,00,000 km.

items.q: A children’s charity wants to raise ₹50,000. A fun run raised ₹18,465 and an online appeal raised ₹23,890. How much more money does the charity need?
In 2,024, 1,28,460 people visited a museum. In 2,025, 15,875 fewer people visited. How many people visited in the two years?
A school raised ₹24,000 for a new library. It spent ₹13,875 on books and ₹6,480 on furniture. How much money is left?
A delivery company’s vans must drive 2,50,000 km this year. They drove 98,476 km in the first four months and 87,950 km in the next four months. How many kilometres are left?
items.e: Step 1, kilometres driven: 98,476 km + 87,950 km = 1,86,426 km. Step 2, kilometres left: 2,50,000 km − 1,86,426 km = 63,574 km. Check: 63,574 km + 1,86,426 km = 2,50,000 km.

items.q: When the Dhillon family bought their van, the odometer showed 48,579 km. Now it shows 2,13,006 km. How far have they driven the van?
items.e: Find the distance between the two readings, so subtract. 2,13,006 − 48,579 = 1,64,427. Check: 1,64,427 + 48,579 = 2,13,006.

items.q: One BC ferry sailed 48,675 km in the spring and 52,390 km in the summer. How far did it sail in the two seasons?
items.e: Put the two seasons together, so add. 48,675 + 52,390 = 1,01,065. Check: 1,01,065 − 52,390 = 48,675.

items.q: Students in a school district set a goal to walk and bike 3,00,000 km to school this year. So far they have logged 1,86,475 km. How many more kilometres do they need?
A SkyTrain station had 2,48,675 riders in September. In October it had 36,480 more riders than in September. How many riders did it have in the two months?
A tree nursery had 4,50,000 cedar seedlings. It sent 2,86,475 to be planted in forests. Then it grew 1,75,650 more. How many seedlings does the nursery have now?
items.e: Step 1, after sending some out: 4,50,000 − 2,86,475 = 1,63,525. Step 2, after growing more: 1,63,525 + 1,75,650 = 3,39,175.

items.q: A library system in the Lower Mainland has 7,50,000 books. 2,86,450 books are checked out and 48,675 are being repaired. How many books are on the shelves?
items.e: Step 1, books not on the shelves: 2,86,450 + 48,675 = 3,35,125. Step 2, books on the shelves: 7,50,000 − 3,35,125 = 4,14,875.
